Equipment
 6.3 kv Vacuum Circuit Breaker 
 3 AF with Motor Operating
 Mechanism EU, EK

This document 
 lists the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on yearly bases as 
 indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The first 
 draft initiated by eng. Ahmed Abel Halim Elangger and reviewed bay eng. 
 Mohamed Salah Badawy accepted by eng. Abdel Rahem Salam general director and 
 approved by eng. Mohamed Enan Head sector of Damietta power station

A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the 
suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area.

Wear appropriate personal protective equipment must be used, safety 
shoes, helmet breathing mask, safety glasses.

items:
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the 
suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area.

Wear appropriate personal protective equipment must be used, safety 
shoes, helmet breathing mask, safety glasses.

The unit must be 
 out of service
Disconnect the circuit breaker and the ground shoe

rows: Clean the mating surface of the metal clad

Check the control voltage value at source of power and line 
 drop between the power source and breaker

Check the racking mechanism to make certain that it is in 
 the disconnect position
Check charging and discharging of the CB
Check the closing time of breaker
Check the tripping time of breaker

Checked the primary circuit insulation on the breaker phase 
 to phase to ground
Check the painting of CB and accessories
Clean the disconnecting switch for the auxiliary transformer
Check the disconnecting switch for the auxiliary transformer
